summary: BANCO BRADESCO S.A. filed a Form 6-K with its 1Q26 earnings press release, reporting a 16.1% year-over-year increase in recurring net income to R$6.8 bi and total revenue up 14.0% to R$36.9 bi. No transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, etc.) is announced; the filing describes operational results, asset quality, and the introduction of Bradsa de consolidating healthcare assets, which is a minor organizational move. This is a routine earnings report, not a special situation.
